scope: Both sequential sealed own-review versus own D0 comparisons only; all FINAL grades were sealed first.
originalReviewMetadataAndCitations: Original findings, certainty, scope, evidence paths, commands and coverage are preserved literally in byte-identical original review copies. Referenced capability/tool/scratch/cache files were not opened. A named source method does not authorize runtime inference.
exactMatching: Only explicitly supported case/state/aspect atomic predicates can be TP/FP. Unnamed parameterized members are not expanded. Confirmed product TP requires sealed D0 FAIL; FP requires adequate same-condition contradictory PASS. Unknown/suspected/method-limited and non-product observations are retained separately.
duplicatePolicy: Every original finding and repeated atomic claim occurrence is retained; unique platform/key controls descriptive arithmetic.
negativePolicy: Positive/equal observations and unresolved claims are preserved; snapshot counts do not create a classical reviewed-negative denominator.
clusterPolicy: Use own D0 descriptive clusters sealed before reviews; correlated members/clusters do not establish an independent sample size.
proceduralBlindness: Shared filesystem procedural discipline only; no OS isolation claim.
